feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 4:04am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 10 September 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure system near Iceland bringing frontal zones across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6, perhaps occasionally 7 late morning and afternoon. Then veering west or southwest 4 or 5 by the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, perhaps occasionally rough for a time around midday or early afternoon. Then becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle spread from the west, before clearing later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing southwest 3 or 4. Then backing south 4 or 5 later, then increasing 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate later, perhaps rough near end of period.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.
